name: py-harness
description: Python project harness: uv, ruff, ty and pytest conventions enforced and explained for Claude Code sessions.
problem: Agents in our Python repos run bare pytest, skip ruff, and write tests that never hit the app; reviewers catch it late.

components.name: uv-runner
components.purpose: Rewrite bare pytest, ruff and mypy invocations to run through uv when the repo has a uv.lock.
facts: ships in hooks/hooks.json under the PreToolUse event with matcher Bash; runs for every user of the plugin
the script is scripts/uv-runner.py, called through ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}
exit code 2 blocks the command and any other failure does not; run /reload-plugins after changes

advice.reason: a rewrite that only ever wraps three fixed commands could be a deny rule such as Bash(pytest *) in the project .claude/settings.json plus a rule file; the hook was kept because the rewrite must also work in repositories without settings

components.name: add-fastapi-route
components.purpose: Add a route the way this team does it: router module, TestClient test, checks through uv.
facts: a skill of the same name in the project or personal scope loads alongside the plugin skill, because plugin skills are namespaced as /plugin-name:skill-name

components.name: test-runner
components.purpose: Run the test suite and return only the failing tests with their assertion output.
facts: after installing the plugin, type @agent-py-harness:test-runner in a session; the typeahead lists plugin agents under their scoped name

components.name: pyright
components.purpose: Give the agent live type diagnostics on .py files.

answers.binary: pyright-langserver, installed by the user via uv tool install pyright

facts: the language server binary must be on the user's PATH

advice.reason: a PostToolUse hook running ty on the edited file gives the same diagnostics without a long-running server

open_questions: Does the team want the hook to also cover `python -m pytest`?

outside_plugin.need: agents must steer to uv for every Python invocation
outside_plugin.where: each repository's .claude/rules/ directory; a plugin cannot ship rules

outside_plugin.need: agents must never pip install into a uv-managed repo
outside_plugin.mechanism: permissions: a deny rule Bash(pip install *)
outside_plugin.where: the team's .claude/settings.json; plugin.json cannot carry permissions
